_readme: Per-instrument CSEntry build versions - the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (tester request 2026-07-02).
Two display surfaces, both stamped FROM this file (never hand-edit them):
1. The .pff Description line -> the app's name in CSEntry's application list and case-listing
2. A build footer on the first cover question (SURVEY_TEAM_LEADER_S_NAME) -> every bug
screenshot identifies its build. Emitted by each instrument's generate_qsf.py.
Policy: Semantic Versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). PATCH = bug-fix deploy (the common mid-round
patch); MINOR = new/changed functionality (new questions, features); MAJOR = UAT round close
or a breaking change (e.g. data shape). Testers are up to date when their app list shows the
version in the latest #f<n>-uat patch note.
Bump with:  py automation/stamp_version.py bump F3 [--minor|--major]   (default = patch;
updates this file, re-stamps the .pff, regenerates the .qsf - one atomic step, no drift).

CHANNEL (2026-08-20, after the PSA submission): each instrument carries a "channel". "release" = a build fit to present as the submitted instrument; anything else ("dev") stamps a [DEV] marker into the .pff Description and the cover build footer, so a work-in-progress app is obvious in the CSEntry app list and on screen. The submitted set is F1 v3.1.5 / F2 v3.0.0 / F3 v6.0.2 / F4 v3.1.3, git tag capi-psa-2026-08-20. Set channel back to "release" only for a build that is genuinely going out as an official version.
